headline: DreamStream reports policy-aligned generative simulation and a closed-loop driving benchmark
summary: A CoRL 2026 paper introduces DreamStream, a closed-loop driving simulator that combines a physics simulator with a distilled autoregressive video model, plus FDπ, a policy-feature alignment metric, and the Navhard-CL benchmark. The authors report FDπ 1.6× lower than the strongest prior closed-loop simulator on nuScenes and 4.7× lower on NAVSIM, and report that simulated policy outcomes vary with observation rendering and reveal scorer, trajectory-coverage and visual-robustness failures. These are author-reported results from selected datasets and policy panels; FDπ is a visual-alignment measure, not real-world safety. The paper says evaluation remains simulated and long-horizon drift persists. The official repository currently says code release is coming soon, so independent reproduction remains open.
